book.name: 1 K'oronttoosa
book.title: P'awuloosi K'oronttoosa Asaw S'aafeedda Koyro Kiitaa

content: Nuuni Kiristtoosa Kak'aabaa Markkatteetto
Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, taani S'oossaa tumatetsaa s'uuraa
hinttenttoo odanaw hinttenttukko yeedda wode, d'ok'k'a k'aalaaninne aad'd'eedda eratetsaan odanaw yabeykke.
Ayaw gooppe, taani hinttenttunna de'aadde, Yesuusi Kiristtoosappenne k'ay mask'k'aliyaa bolla misimaariyan d'ishettiide I kak'etteeddawaappe attin, harabaa erennaadan, ta k'ofaa k'achchaad.
Taani daaburaaninne yashshaan daro kokkorssaan hinttenttunna de'aaddi.
Taani tamaarissiyaawaanne odiyaawaa S'oossaa Ayyaanaaninne wolk'k'aan k'onc'c'issayppe attin, c'iimma gidiide aad'd'eedda eratetsaa k'aalaanna gidenna.
Hewaa diraw, hintte ammanuu S'oossaa wolk'k'aanappe attin, asaa aad'd'o eratetsaan zemppibeenna.
S'oossaa Aad'd'eedda Eraa
Nuuni ayyaanan wozanaamatuwaa giddon aad'd'o eratetsaa haasayeetto. Shin hewekka ha alamiyaa aad'd'o eratetsaa gidenna; woy ha alamiyaa mooddiyaa d'ayiyaawanttu aad'd'o eratetsaa gidenna.
Shin nuuni odiyaa aad'd'o eratetsay, S'oossay kasetiide, c'ora wodiyaappe kase nu bonchchoo dooreedda asaappe geemmeedda Aa s'uuraa aad'd'o eratetsaa.
Ha alamiyaa mooddiyaawanttuppe ooninne ha aad'd'o eratetsaa eribeenna. Unttunttu ereeddawaa gidintto, bonchcho Godaa mask'k'aliyaa bolla misimaariyan d'ishiide kak'k'ikkino.
Shin S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
giyaawaadan nuuni haasayeetto.
S'oossay bare S'uura yewuwaa bare Ayyaanaan nuuna erisseedda; ayaw gooppe, Geeshsha Ayyaanay S'oossaabaa haray atto geemmeedda yewuwaa ubbaa biddee.
Ayaw gooppe, asaan de'iyaa asaa ayyaanaappe attin, asaabaa eriyaawe oonee? Hawaadankka, k'ay S'oossaabaa S'oossaa Ayyaanaappe attin, ooninne erenna.
Nuuni S'oossay nuw immeeddabaa ubbaa eranaw I nuw yeddeedda Ayaanaa akkeeddoppe attin, alamiyaa ayaanaa akkibeykko.
Nuuni ayaanaa yewuwaa
ayaanaa yewuwaanna gatsiide, Geeshsha Ayyaanay nuuna tamaarisseedda k'aalaan hawaa haasayeettoppe attin, asaa aad'd'o eratetsay nuuna tamaarisseedda k'aalaan haasayokko.
Shin Geeshsha Ayyaanay baynna Asay S'oossaa Ayaanaa yewuwaa akkena; ayaw gooppe, hewe aw eeyatetsaa. Yewuu Geeshsha Ayyaanan paac'ettiyaa diraw, I eranaw danddayenna.
Shin Geeshsha Ayyaanay de'iyaa Asay ubbabaa shaakkee; shin I bare huup'ew oonaninne shaakettenna.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa mas'aafay,
yaagee. Shin nuw Kiristtoosa wozanay de'ee.

footnotes.text: S'oossaa tumatetsaa s'uuraa: Itti itti Geeshsha Mas'aafaa biletsatuu, S'oossaabaa markkatetsaa, yaagiino.
Ayaanaa yewuwaa: Geeshsha Ayyaanay immeedda k'aalaa.
Nuw Kiristtoosa wozanay de'ee: Hawaa guussay, nuuni Kiristtoosi k'oppiyaawaadan k'oppeetto guussaa.
